description: This Java source file defines a REST exception handler class 'HttpMessageNotReadableErrorController' that implements custom handling for 'HttpMessageNotReadableException'. It logs the error, generates a standardized API error response with a specific error code, and produces a JSON Response indicating a bad request due to invalid JSON data.

classes.name: HttpMessageNotReadableErrorController
classes.description: A REST exception handler that manages 'HttpMessageNotReadableException' errors, converting them into standardized JSON API error responses with HTTP 400 status.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an 'HttpMessageNotReadableException' into a JAX-RS Response with error details.

methods.name: errorCode
